evidence_concerns.source_locator: Results and discussion, first paragraph; Tables 5 and 6
evidence_concerns.message: The text's summary does not match the tables: it lists ProtT5 among structure embeddings while the tables print ProstT5; it reports a GraphSAGE with DistMult result (+38% Hits@100 on HuRI) although DistMult is not a column; and the stated gains (for example ESM-2 with GraphSAGE +6% Hits@100 on OGBl-ppa) cannot be reproduced from the printed table values (GS random 0.0104, ESM-2 0.2421). Values are kept as printed; comparisons should rely on the tables only after a reviewer has judged this. Random-feature baselines on OGBl-ppa (GCN 0.0588, GS 0.0104 Hits@100) look far below the public OGB leaderboard values the authors say they reproduced (Supplementary Table S2, not retrieved; reviewer did not verify the leaderboard values).
